Send Marcus Johnson a coordination message using the comprehensive contextual snapshot format I established earlier today. answer:
Hi Marcus,

Here's what's been going on — hoping to make it back for Saturday's run. Is the group still planning to meet up?

**Quick catch-up on my end:**
Work's been pretty full-on lately. Just wrapped a major project architecture review on June 5th, and I've got a wrap-up meeting on the 25th. July brings my mid-year review on the 14th, then straight into strategy sessions and Q3 planning. Still a lot of moving pieces with the team.

On the personal side, I've got a dentist appointment I still need to schedule (kept pushing it), and my HVAC filter is definitely overdue — meant to handle it in early June. Nothing major, just the usual adulting backlog.

**Fitness-wise:** I've still been getting out when I can. Did a trail run last Sunday — 12K in Forest Park, humid but felt good. CrossFit session the week before that. Been mixing it up with swimming and cycling too. Definitely miss the Saturday group runs though; the solo miles aren't the same.

**For Saturday:** I should be clear. No work conflicts that morning that I can see. Let me know if you all are meeting at the usual time and place — I'll aim to be there.

– Alice
